question.text: GTC (Good Till Cancelled) and GTD (Good Till Date) orders are currently:

answer.text: Not available on the system as per SEBI directives

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI directives, Good Till Cancelled (GTC) and Good Till Date (GTD) orders are currently not available on the system. The time-condition section of the workbook flags these as unavailable. The Trap: It is tempting to assume only DAY and IOC remain as time conditions, but the same section also references Cancel on Logout without stating it is unavailable. Restrict the answer to what the source explicitly says: GTC and GTD are unavailable. Note: Separately, All-Or-None (AON) and Minimum Fill (MF) are listed as unavailable quantity conditions. Do not conflate the time-condition restrictions with the quantity-condition restrictions.
